hours.why: Seven at night is when the lamp goes on and the bedtime story starts, so the moon should arrive with it.

day_sound.tune: The same friendly tune, just a little lighter, like a morning song you hum while getting dressed.

night_sound.tune: A lullaby on the same five notes, lower and slower, like a music box winding down beside the bed.

finale.day: A happy run up to the top that ends in a bright, open chord, like a sunny 'ta-da'.
finale.night: A soft run that settles into a warm low chord with one last star-twinkle on top, like 'goodnight'.

avoid: Avoid the glass harmonica and any half-step scale at night, because eerie rubbing notes in the dark can feel spooky to a child.
